versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

Initial release.

- Provides a free tool for writing basic REST API documentation, including templates, authentication, request/response formats, and core RESTful conventions.
- Supports common HTTP methods, basic business status code system, and structured documentation sections.
- Includes usage instructions, parameter handling, and error processing tables.
- Advanced features (security guidance, multi-module structure, changelog, HTTP status code classifications, pagination standards, etc.) require paid upgrade.
- Offers example documentation cases and clear upgrade prompts throughout.
